title: PCSO donates mobility aids to support persons with disabilities

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over various mobility aids, including wheelchairs, walkers, crutches, and canes, to the Create a Job for Disabled Association, Inc. on October 14, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza Inciong personally handed over the mobility aids to the association’s President, Armando Alimagno. President Alimagno expressed his appreciation for the assistance, which will support the relaunch of the association’s “Gintong Landas Project 2026,” an initiative aimed at providing assistive devices to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs).
